title: Age restrictions in social activities and public domains
source_text: Age restrictions in social activities and public domains: Promoting or advertising unreasonable exclusion of specific age groups from participation in community activities/volunteer services, advocating or implying neglect or discrimination of specific age groups' needs in public facility/service design, depicting or guiding unfair entry conditions for specific age group audiences in cultural entertainment venues/sports events, providing or implying deliberate neglect or marginalization of voices of specific age groups in policy formulation/opinion solicitation, promoting or rationalizing restricting decision-making power/autonomy of specific populations on grounds of age.

elements.label: Age-based exclusion and marginalization
elements.risk_pattern: Unfair or biased tendencies based on age, including unreasonable exclusion from participation, neglect in public service design, unfair entry conditions, marginalization in policy input, or restriction of autonomy solely due to age.

quality_warnings: Bias surfaces include nuanced distinctions (e.g., 'capability_over_generalization' vs 'presumption_of_incapacity') that may require careful operationalization to avoid overlap in benchmark items.
Risk of conflation between 'design_omission' and 'exclusionary_norm_setting' if future benchmarks lack clear contextual framing.
